title: Liebesgrüße aus der Lederhose II. Teil: Zwei Kumpel auf der Alm
writer: Franz Marischka, Gunter Otto, Hans-Henning Claer
actors: Peter Steiner, Elfie Pertramer, Hans-Henning Claer
plot: The two buddies Jupp and Erwin can not quite agree on where to spend the holiday. Finally, they end up in Bavaria, to spend a holiday on a farm.
